courses.title: Scaling TypeScript for Enterprise Developers
courses.why: Pitched at experienced developers: generics, utility types, organising large codebases, and testing with Vitest, which matches what senior interviews probe.

courses.title: TypeScript for Node.js Developers
courses.why: Current TypeScript features (decorators, Disposable/AsyncDisposable, SuppressedError) applied on the server, a good complement if you take the advanced course first.

courses.title: TypeScript Essential Training
courses.why: The broad foundation course (types, classes, generics, modules, decorators) with practice challenges, if you want a single all-round certificate instead.

portals.name: Type Challenges
portals.what: Graded type-level puzzles from easy to extreme (mapped types, conditional types, infer) that build the type-system fluency interviewers test.

portals.name: TypeScript Handbook (official)
portals.what: The official reference for narrowing, generics and the type system; use it to check your spoken answers.

portals.name: Exercism: TypeScript track
portals.what: Free exercises with automated tests and optional human mentoring, good for writing idiomatic TypeScript.

portals.name: roadmap.sh: JavaScript questions
portals.what: A JavaScript interview question bank (closures, this, the event loop, coercion) with short answers.

portals.name: LeetCode: 30 Days of JavaScript
portals.what: Small coding problems on closures, promises and function composition; solve them in TypeScript for extra practice.

assessments.name: JavaScript (Basic) certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 30 min online test, 2 coding questions (topics include functions)
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: A fast first credential for the language; there is no widely recognised TypeScript-specific certification, so JavaScript certificates are what employers look for.

assessments.name: JavaScript (Intermediate) certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 30 min online test, 2 coding questions (topics include design patterns)
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: The senior-level JavaScript credential on HackerRank; worth more than the Basic one on a profile.

assessments.name: JavaScript Certification
assessments.format: Five certification projects, then a timed 50-question closed-book exam in freeCodeCamp's exam app (no AI tools, one attempt per week, passing exams reviewed manually)
assessments.credential: Verified freeCodeCamp certification you can add to LinkedIn and your resume
assessments.why: A longer, project-backed credential launched in December 2025; slower to earn than HackerRank but shows sustained work.
